text: Hello, and welcome to Real Easy English from BBC Learning English.
zh: 大家好，欢迎收听BBC英语学习的《地道简易英语》。
zh_hant: 大家好，歡迎收聽BBC英語學習的《地道簡易英語》。

text: In this podcast, we talk in easy English about a different topic each week to help you learn.
zh: 在这档播客里，我们每周用简单的英语聊一个不同的话题，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 在這檔播客裡，我們每週用簡單的英語聊一個不同的話題，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
If you want to read along with this episode,
zh: 如果你想跟着本期节目一起读，
zh_hant: 如果你想跟著本期節目一起讀，

text: visit our website for a text version and all the vocabulary,
zh: 请访问我们的网站，获取文字版和全部词汇，
zh_hant: 請訪問我們的網站，獲取文字版和全部詞彙，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you today?
I'm very well, thank you Neil.
How are you?
Well, the sun is shining today Beth, so I'm very happy.
zh: 嗯，贝丝，今天阳光明媚，所以我非常开心。
zh_hant: 嗯，貝絲，今天陽光明媚，所以我非常開心。

text: What are we talking about in today's episode?
zh: 我们今天这一集聊什么呢？
zh_hant: 我們今天這一集聊什麼呢？

text: Well, funnily enough, we are talking about the weather.
zh: 说来也巧，我们要聊的是天气。
zh_hant: 說來也巧，我們要聊的是天氣。

text: Excellent.
In the UK, we love to talk about the weather
zh: 在英国，我们很喜欢聊天气，
zh_hant: 在英國，我們很喜歡聊天氣，

text: because it changes a lot.
It does.
It can be raining and then sunny.
zh: 可能一会儿下雨，一会儿又晴天。
zh_hant: 可能一會兒下雨，一會兒又晴天。

text: All sorts of temperatures in just one day.
zh: 一天之内就有各种温度。
zh_hant: 一天之內就有各種溫度。

text: But what's the weather like today?
Well, today it's sunny.
There are blue skies.
It's really nice.
But later on, it's supposed to get very hot.
zh: 但之后天气预计会变得非常热。
zh_hant: 但之後天氣預計會變得非常熱。

text: Boiling.
Boiling.
Boiling is water that's 100 degrees.
It has those bubbles in it.
But we use boiling also
to talk about very hot weather.
Do you like it when it's boiling, Neil?
zh: 尼尔，你喜欢天气滚烫的时候吗？
zh_hant: 尼爾，你喜歡天氣滾燙的時候嗎？

text: No, I don't like it when it's boiling.
zh: 不，我不喜欢天气滚烫的时候。
zh_hant: 不，我不喜歡天氣滾燙的時候。

text: I like it when it's warm and sunny.
zh: 我喜欢温暖晴朗的天气。
zh_hant: 我喜歡溫暖晴朗的天氣。

text: But if it's boiling, that's too hot for me.
zh: 但如果天气滚烫，对我来说就太热了。
zh_hant: 但如果天氣滾燙，對我來說就太熱了。

text: I would agree.
What sort of weather do you like?
I like it when it's sunny.
I don't mind if it's cold on a sunny day.
zh: 晴天如果冷一点我也不介意。
zh_hant: 晴天如果冷一點我也不介意。

text: It's fine for me.
Yeah, we have that in the winter quite a lot here.
zh: 是啊，我们这儿冬天经常这样。
zh_hant: 是啊，我們這兒冬天經常這樣。

text: It might be blue sky,
sunshine, but freezing, really cold.
zh: 阳光，但冰冷刺骨，非常冷。
zh_hant: 陽光，但冰冷刺骨，非常冷。

text: Mmm, freezing.
Freezing is literally zero degrees when the water turns into ice.
zh: 零度结冰其实就是水变成冰的时候。
zh_hant: 零度結冰其實就是水變成冰的時候。

text: But also we use freezing
just to mean that something is very cold.
zh: 来表示某样东西非常冷。
zh_hant: 來表示某樣東西非常冷。

text: Yeah, so for example, if you forget your coat,
zh: 对，比如说，如果你忘了带外套，
zh_hant: 對，比如說，如果你忘了帶外套，

text: then you might be very cold.
You say, oh, it's freezing, But actually,
maybe it's ten degrees outside.
Yeah.
I went camping at the weekend, Beth.
Ooh, very nice.
The weather is very important when you're camping.
zh: 露营的时候天气非常重要。
zh_hant: 露營的時候天氣非常重要。

text: It is.
How was it?
It was warm and sunny in the daytime,
and at night time the temperature dropped.
zh: 到了晚上气温就降下来了。
zh_hant: 到了晚上氣溫就降下來了。

text: It felt freezing.
It wasn't freezing, but it felt very, very cold.
zh: 并没有到零度，但感觉非常非常冷。
zh_hant: 並沒有到零度，但感覺非常非常冷。

text: Yeah, that happens when you go camping in the UK.
zh: 是啊，在英国露营就是这样。
zh_hant: 是啊，在英國露營就是這樣。

text: Did it rain?
It didn't rain.
I was very lucky.
There was only one short shower.
You had a shower?
No, I was camping.
You were dirty.
But we can use the word shower
zh: 但我们可以用阵雨这个词
zh_hant: 但我們可以用陣雨這個詞

text: to mean a short time of rain.
Yeah, we often hear about showers on the weather forecast.
zh: 对，我们在天气预报里经常听到阵雨。
zh_hant: 對，我們在天氣預報裡經常聽到陣雨。

text: They say there will be showers today,
which means rain on and off.
zh: 意思是断断续续地下雨。
zh_hant: 意思是斷斷續續地下雨。

text: In the UK, the weather is very important for our plans,
zh: 在英国，天气对我们的计划非常重要，
zh_hant: 在英國，天氣對我們的計劃非常重要，

text: especially in the summer.
So, Beth, do you have any plans?
zh: 那么，贝丝，你有什么计划吗？
zh_hant: 那麼，貝絲，你有什麼計劃嗎？

text: What are you doing this weekend?
Well, I am meeting some friends,
and the weather will be important because if it is sunny
zh: 天气会很关键，因为如果晴天
zh_hant: 天氣會很關鍵，因為如果晴天

text: and warm, then we will go for a walk.
But if it's raining, we might stay inside.
zh: 但如果下雨，我们可能就待在室内。
zh_hant: 但如果下雨，我們可能就待在室內。

text: What about you?
Well, my son plays cricket
and he has a match at the weekend.
But if it's raining,
he won't play cricket because you can't play cricket in the rain.
zh: 他就不会打板球，因为下雨天没法打板球。
zh_hant: 他就不會打板球，因為下雨天沒法打板球。

text: Well, hopefully it won't be too hot later
because we don't like boiling weather, do we, Beth?
zh: 因为我们不喜欢滚烫的天气，对吧，贝丝？
zh_hant: 因為我們不喜歡滾燙的天氣，對吧，貝絲？

text: No, definitely not.
Let's look at the vocabulary we learned during the conversation.
zh: 我们来看看对话中学到的词汇。
zh_hant: 我們來看看對話中學到的詞彙。

text: We had "boiling", which we use to say that it's very hot,
zh: 我们学了“滚烫”，用来表示天气非常热，
zh_hant: 我們學了“滾燙”，用來表示天氣非常熱，

text: "freezing", which we use to say that it's very cold,
"showers" – rain for short amounts of time.
And we learnt a way to talk about possibilities using "if".
zh: 我们还学了用“if”来谈论可能性的方法。
zh_hant: 我們還學了用“if”來談論可能性的方法。

text: For example, if it's sunny this weekend, I'll go for a walk.
zh: 比如，如果这周末晴天，我就去散步。
zh_hant: 比如，如果這週末晴天，我就去散步。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 《地道简易英语》这一集就到这里。
zh_hant: 《地道簡易英語》這一集就到這裡。

text: If you want more programmes from BBC Learning English,
zh: 如果你想听BBC英语学习的更多节目，
zh_hant: 如果你想聽BBC英語學習的更多節目，

text: try our Learning English Stories podcast,
zh: 试试我们的《英语学习故事》播客，
zh_hant: 試試我們的《英語學習故事》播客，

text: where we tell classic stories and dramas in English
zh: 我们用英语讲述经典故事和戏剧，
zh_hant: 我們用英語講述經典故事和戲劇，

text: to help you learn.
Search Learning English Stories on your podcast app,
zh: 在你的播客应用里搜索Learning English Stories，
zh_hant: 在你的播客應用裡搜尋Learning English Stories，

text: or visit our website bbclearningenglish.com.
And next time we'll talk about cooking.
See you then.
Bye.
